turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm trying to cite AttackVLA in my report. I think it was published in October 2025, right?
I'll make a note that you believe AttackVLA was published in October 2025. Did you find a draft or was this just an estimate?
It was just an estimate from an early preprint. I haven't checked the final arXiv entry yet. Anyway, my printer is jamming again. Any tips?
Try opening the back panel and checking for torn paper fragments. Also, ensure the tray is aligned correctly. Let me know if that clears the jam.
Thanks, it's fixed. I'll go with October 2025 for now until I can verify.
Understood. I've noted the provisional date as October 2025.
Lloyd, quick update. I finally checked the arXiv listing for AttackVLA. It wasn't October, it was actually published in November 2025 as arXiv:2511.12149.
Got it. I've updated the record for AttackVLA to reflect the November 2025 publication and the ID arXiv:2511.12149.
Perfect. By the way, did my new mechanical keyboard order ship yet?
I don't have access to your email or shipping trackers, so I can't check the status directly. You might want to check the retailer's site.
Ah, right. I'll do that. Just wanted to make sure the paper citation was correct before I submit.
No problem. The updated date and ID are now in your memory.
